title: Child marriage before 18, SDG regions compared, by location
headline: In 107 of 119 countries, child marriage was higher in rural than in urban areas in the latest survey
subtitle: Percentage of women (aged 20-24 years) married or in union before age 18
years: Latest surveys with both groups, 2006 to 2025; median gap 10.1 points.
data_line: Data: UNICEF Data Warehouse via UN System Data Commons, indicator PT_MRD_U18, extracted 1 Nov 2026
alt: In 107 of 119 countries, child marriage was higher in rural than in urban areas in the latest survey. Latest surveys with both groups, 2006 to 2025; median gap 10.1 points. Gap between rural areas and urban areas in 119 countries, ranked; 107 with rural areas higher, 10 with urban areas higher.
method: Method: gap within each country's latest survey with both groups.
question: Where have you seen the gap in child marriage between rural areas and urban areas close, and how was it measured?
